# Law Office of Jacquelyn R. Goncalves

> Immigration law firm in Mystic, Connecticut, led by attorney Jacquelyn R. Goncalves. The firm focuses on family-based immigration — green cards, marriage and fiancé petitions, adjustment of status, naturalization, and USCIS filings — with direct attorney involvement on every case. Services are offered in English, Spanish, and Portuguese to clients across Connecticut and nationwide.

## About the firm

- Attorney: Jacquelyn R. Goncalves
- Office: 12 Roosevelt Ave, Ste 9B, Mystic, CT 06355
- Phone: (860) 471-3023
- Email: jr@jacquelynrgoncalveslaw.com
- Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–6:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM–2:00 PM
- Service area: Connecticut (statewide) and clients nationwide/worldwide

## Services

- [Family-Based Petitions](https://www.jacqlaw.com/services/family-based-petitions): Sponsoring relatives for green cards via Form I-130.
- [Adjustment of Status](https://www.jacqlaw.com/services/adjustment-of-status): Applying for permanent residence from inside the U.S. (Form I-485).
- [Consular Processing](https://www.jacqlaw.com/services/consular-processing): Immigrant visa processing through a U.S. consulate abroad.
- [Removal of Conditions](https://www.jacqlaw.com/services/removal-of-conditions): Form I-751 to remove conditions on a marriage-based green card.
- [Citizenship & Naturalization](https://www.jacqlaw.com/services/citizenship-naturalization): N-400 naturalization from application to oath.
- [Fiancé Petitions](https://www.jacqlaw.com/services/fiance-petitions): K-1 fiancé visas for U.S. citizens.
- [Work Permit Renewal](https://www.jacqlaw.com/services/work-permit-renewal): Renewing employment authorization (Form I-765).
- [Green Card Renewal](https://www.jacqlaw.com/services/green-card-renewal): Renewing or replacing a permanent resident card (Form I-90).
- [VAWA](https://www.jacqlaw.com/services/vawa): Self-petitions for survivors under the Violence Against Women Act.
- [DACA Renewal](https://www.jacqlaw.com/services/daca-renewal): Renewing Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals.
- [E-2 Investment Visa](https://www.jacqlaw.com/services/e2-investment-visa): Treaty investor visa guidance.
- [B-1/B-2 Renewal](https://www.jacqlaw.com/services/b1-b2-renewal): Renewing visitor visa status.
